children: Catcher Predict reported that the MOUZ option in Polymarket's submarket for the Counter-Strike ESL Pro League playoff match between MOUZ and Spirit, specifically the "Map 1 Winner" market, saw sharp volatility. According to ChainCatcher, the odds rose from 42.5% one hour earlier to 58.5% at the time of reporting, a 16% increase. The update said the move may have been affected by breaking news.

title: Catcher Predict: MOUZ Map 1 Winner Odds Surge 16% in ESL Pro League Playoff Match Against Spirit
